intro.caster: Ladies and gentlemen! Welcome to THE TROPHY ROAD! Seventeen arenas! Zero financial advice!

basement.caster: Arena one! Mom's Basement! Our hero has a dream, a hoodie, and Wi-Fi!

backyard.caster: Arena two! Backyard Barbecue! Rubber ducks! Lawn chairs! Absolutely zero fire safety!

parking.caster: Arena three! The Strip Mall Lot! Cheap parking, big dreams, and one very haunted shopping cart!

plaza.caster: Plaza After Dark! Neon! Sirens! And a liquidity pool of questionable depth!

beach.caster: Muscle Beach! Sun's out! Guns are out! Gains are, honestly, theoretical!

exchange.caster: The Trading Floor! Green candles! Red candles! A guy screaming BUY at absolutely nothing!
exchange.analyst: He has no position. Just passion.

casino.caster: Degen Casino! The house always wins! Unless you ask the house. The house says it's fine!

cold.caster: Cold Storage! Frozen wallets! Frostbitten bags! Somebody lost their seed phrase in the ice!
cold.analyst: Check the freezer. Then check it again.

penthouse.caster: Lambo Penthouse! Marble floors! Gold everything! And a Lambo that is definitely not leased!

moon.caster: To The Moon! Zero gravity! Infinite hype! And the chart only goes up! Allegedly!

factory.caster: The Memecoin Factory! Fresh tokens, straight off the line! Quality control left in twenty twenty-one!

dump.caster: The Dump! Bags go in! Regret comes out! Please, no refunds!

cemetery.caster: Coin Cemetery! Rest in peace, old tickers! They had a roadmap! They had a community! They had a Discord!

trench.caster: Whale Trench! Deep waters! Bigger fish! One wrong move and you are the liquidity!

mine.caster: Diamond Hands Mine! Hold the line! Never sell! Never blink! Never check the price!

clouds.caster: Copium Clouds! Breathe in! It's all still going up! Breathe out! Still going up!
clouds.analyst: It is not still going up.

metaverse.caster: The Metaverse! The final arena! Look at that crowd!

mA.caster: Then the road gets weird! The Backyard! The Strip Mall! Plaza After Dark!

mC.caster: The Factory! The Dump! The Mine!

outro.caster: Seventeen arenas! One road! More memes! More arenas! More chaos! Play it now on PC and mobile!
